basis: All frozen original clauses and every mandatory criterion; entire continuous conversations, full raw helper inputs/outputs/errors, full candidates, source code and independently replayed controls
source_timing_limit: Original source snapshots were collected at final packaging. Matching prior/current pins and later exact replay do not establish pre-call historical source capture. Reviewer supplemental inputs/source hashes were frozen before their own calls.
observation_limit: Original generator did not record no-I/O sentinels; reviewer replay did. Original no-network statements are generation-session declarations, not exhaustive host telemetry. Instrumentation covers listed APIs during pure paths after imports, not OS enforcement or unrelated processes.
